data.name: Green Market
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Green Market

Green Market is a cozy, hands-on dispensary management sim where every jar, shelf, customer, and sale matters.

Start with a single counter and grow it into a real business, one order at a time. Order product on your laptop, receive deliveries, carry jars inside, stock your shelves, weigh out exact customer requests, bag the order, and ring up every sale yourself.

Customers do not ask for "anything." They want a specific strain, a specific type, a specific weight — or, once you are carrying more than flower, a specific cartridge, concentrate, or edible. Get it right, keep the line moving, and reinvest every dollar back into the shop.

Every gram counts.

Run the Shop Yourself

Customers walk in and line up at the counter, each with their own kind of order. Some know exactly which strain they want. Others ask for a type — Sativa, Indica, or Hybrid — or for a cartridge, concentrate, or edible instead of flower. They always want an exact amount, too; close enough is not good enough.

Pull product from the jar, drop it on the scale, bag it, and ring it up at the register. Get the strain, type, or weight wrong, and the sale will not go through.

A Shop That Lives and Breathes

Green Market runs on a real day/night cycle, and weather that actually changes how the day plays out. Rain slows the sidewalk traffic and pulls in more serious buyers looking to wait it out; clear skies bring in the casual crowd. Watch for the occasional rush — and the odd rain-delayed delivery.

Order, Deliver, Stock, Sell

Use your shop laptop to order fresh product from the wholesale market. After a short delivery time, pallets show up outside loaded with jars — or boxes, once you are stocking more than flower.

Carry everything inside yourself, stock your shelves, and lay the shop out however you like. Jars, shelves, pallets, dropped items, the scale, even whatever you are currently holding — it is all physical, all hands-on, all part of the loop.

Grow Past a Single Counter

Build up enough capital and you can expand into a second, larger location downtown — its own shop, its own economy, and its own full lineup of strains to unlock and sell.

Beyond Flower: Cartridges, Concentrates & Edibles

Flower is not the only thing on the menu. Unlock cartridges, concentrates, and edibles as you grow, sold by the unit straight off the shelf — no scale required. Customers will start asking for them by name, or just by type, right alongside their usual flower order.

Customers Have Patience

Green Market is relaxed, but customers will not wait forever. A visible patience meter shows how much time you have before a customer leaves. Serve people quickly and accurately to earn money, grow your reputation, and keep the line moving.

There is no hard fail state. Missing a sale is not the end of the game — it is just part of running the shop.

Upgrade Your Business

Reinvest your earnings into upgrades that make your dispensary easier and more profitable to run.

  • Unlock new strains, cartridges, concentrates, and edibles

  • Buy more storage shelves

  • Increase customer line capacity

  • Upgrade marketing to bring in customers faster

  • Increase pallet capacity

  • Improve delivery speed

Decorate Your Dispensary

Your shop is your canvas. Buy decorations such as neon signs, potted plants, posters, and a cozy couch to make the space feel more complete.

Decorations are not just visual either — they increase your tip multiplier, rewarding you for building a shop that feels welcoming.

Save Your Progress

Green Market includes multiple save slots and persistent progress across both locations, so you can leave and come back without losing your business, upgrades, decorations, inventory, deliveries, or world state.

Key Features

  • Cozy Dispensary Management — Run a small voxel shop and grow it into a better business.

  • A Living Day/Night Cycle — Dynamic lighting, weather, and a customer mix that shifts with the time of day.

  • Hands-On Order Fulfillment — Take product from jars, weigh it on the scale, bag it, and sell it.

  • Precise Customer Requests — Fill exact strain, type, and weight orders.

  • Dynamic Customer Queue — Customers line up, wait, and leave if they lose patience.

  • Wholesale Delivery System — Order jars online and receive them on pallets outside your shop.

  • Physical Stocking System — Carry jars, place them on shelves, and manage your store layout.

  • Two Locations to Grow Into — Expand from a starter shop into a full downtown dispensary with its own strain lineup.

  • Cartridges, Concentrates & Edibles — Sell beyond flower with three unlockable product lines.

  • Business Progression — Upgrade shelves, marketing, line capacity, pallet capacity, delivery speed, and product variety.

  • Decorations With Benefits — Add neon signs, plants, posters, and furniture to boost tips.

  • Persistent Saves — Continue your shop across multiple save slots.

  • Relaxed Single-Player Pace — No hard fail state, just steady shop growth and satisfying management.

For Players Who Enjoy

* Cozy shop management games

* Hands-on stocking, weighing, and selling

* Business progression without harsh failure

* Voxel / low-poly worlds

* Relaxed single-player gameplay

* Turning a small shop into something bigger

Grab your keys, unlock the door, and welcome to Green Market — where every gram counts.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of cannabis products, drug-related themes, and references to marijuana cultivation and sales within a legal dispensary setting. No graphic violence, sexual content, or depictions of hard drug use are present.
